{{Quote|Antilles, are you demanding surrender?''"<br />"''Negative. Here's the deal. You break off hostilities, we do, too. Go wherever you care to. We've won this round. Neither one of us gains from continuing this battle.''"<br />"''Not correct. You die, we gain. Prepare to eat vacuum.|''Implacable'' captain to Wedge Antilles.|<ref name="WS" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the [[Captain/Legends|'''captain''']] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']]'', ''which served in the fleet of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

==History==
{{Quote|Captain, accept the commander's offer.''"<br />"''You're only an observer here. You don't issue orders to-"|[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] to ''Implacable'' captain.|<ref name="WS" />}}
The captain was aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']] during the [[Battle of Ession]] against [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces. When the tide of battle began to favor the New Republic forces, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]] escaped from the ''Implacable'' by flying his personal [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] out of the engagement. Trigit left instructions not to surrender and the captain was left in charge of the dying ship. He followed the Admiral's order by rejecting [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] offer to break off hostilities where both sides would retreat. The captain was determined to fight on and kill as many New Republic personnel despite [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]]&mdash;leader of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] famed [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]]&mdash;recommendation to accept the offer. The captain proceeded to remind the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] that he was not in charge and merely an observer when he was shot by Fel, who then took over command of the ship and accepted Antilles's offer.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
It is not known if the captain survived the [[Battle of Ession]] after being shot by Soontir Fel, as there was no indication whether the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] Fel used was set to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] or not.<ref name="WS" />

The man who shot him was actually [[holostar]] [[Tetran Cowall]] in disguise as Fel as part of Zsinj's plan to trap [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="WS" />
